item.title: U.S. Forces Stand Ready to Resume Combat. The President May Not Be as Enthused.
item.summary: President Trump knows that even if a cease-fire runs out with no final agreement on the issues dividing Washington and Tehran, the political risk of renewing hostilities is high.

item.title: Gulf Arab nations report a barrage of Iranian attacks since the cease-fire.
What Trump Has Accomplished in Iran After 5 Weeks of War
item.summary: President Trump said “we have already met and exceeded” his military objectives. But his goals are largely unresolved.

item.title: Hegseth Demands Iran Turn Over Uranium Stockpiles
item.summary: The American defense secretary warned President Trump could still order a commando raid to seize 970 pounds of enriched uranium buried in Isfahan if Iran does not agree.

item.title: After Cease-Fire, Iranians Are Left to Pick Up the Pieces
item.summary: Hours after a tenuous pause to a six-week war, Iranians expressed relief and trepidation about the future. Some fear the government will crack down on its domestic critics.

item.title: After Iran Cease-Fire, Ship Traffic in Strait of Hormuz Remains Throttled
item.summary: A handful of vessels have crossed the crucial waterway since the U.S.-Iran truce began, but shipowners, insurers and others are wary of safe passage.

item.title: War Decimated Iran’s Leadership and Pushed Up a New Generation
item.summary: Since the killing of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, authority has shifted to the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps. Younger military leaders have come to the fore.

item.title: Gulf Nations Face New Reality, Whether Cease-Fire Holds or Not
item.summary: The countries will have to re-evaluate their relationships with Israel, Iran and the United States after a war that has exposed their vulnerability.

item.title: China Pressed Iran Toward Cease-fire, Iranian Officials Say
item.summary: Beijing appeared to have helped push Tehran to accept the two-week deal with the United States, reflecting China’s growing influence and its stake in avoiding a wider war.

item.title: Israel Says Iran Cease-Fire Does Not Extend to Lebanon and Continues Strikes
item.summary: Deadly airstrikes pummeled Lebanon in Israel’s largest bombing wave yet in the monthlong war with Iran-backed Hezbollah.
